# Tap Time Breaker

<p class="ttb-project__type">Idle/clicker mobile game</p>

<p class="ttb-project__status">Active development · private source code</p>

## Overview

Tap Time Breaker is an idle/clicker mobile game developed in Unity by a two-person team. The project combines passive progression with active interactions, around combat, progression, and collection systems.

## Technologies

<p class="ttb-project__technologies"><span>Core technologies&nbsp;:</span> Unity · C# · Firebase</p>

## My role

I contribute to programming, game design, game-system design, and project documentation. Development is shared with my teammate: this page describes my scope without assigning the entire game to one person.

## Project development

<p class="ttb-development">The project is developed by a two-person team under student-entrepreneur status. Work is organized around a shared scope, with Unity, C#, and Firebase among the project’s core technologies.</p>
